title: Make task-ranking system self-evaluating with automatic strategy selection
context: Task ranking needed validation: is ranking actually better than just using the latest task? Without knowing, ranking might silently degrade or fail without being noticed.
decision: Continuously evaluate the ranking strategy via leave-one-out validation on every task write. Automatically switch delivery from 'ranked' to 'latest' if ranking confidence drops. Surface the verdict in `hunch now` and `hunch task stats` commands. Record all verdict changes as findings for audit trail.
consequences: Ranking system self-corrects: no manual configuration needed to know if it's working
Users get transparency into ranking quality via explicit verdict output
System degrades gracefully when ranking loses confidence instead of silently failing
Verdict changes create a traceable history of strategy decisions
Evaluation cost is paid on every task write (continuous vs. periodic)
alternatives_rejected: Keep ranking static and require manual periodic evaluation
Only evaluate ranking health on demand or scheduled intervals
Switch strategies silently without surfacing verdict to users
Expose evaluation results only in logs, not user-facing commands
